articles.summary: Interface, Inc., the global flooring and sustainability leader, today introduced Twist & Texture™, its latest carpet tile collection featuring seven textile-inspired styles. For designers managing fast-moving projects, the collection pairs sophisticated design with one affordable price point and three-week QuickShip availability. Its color palette of warm neutrals and subtle accents gives designers the flexibility to create calm, inviting spaces across a variety of commercial environments.
articles.title: Interface Unveils Twist & Texture™ Carpet Tile Collection
